profile.headline: Design Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a Design Engineer with deep experience in CSS architecture, semantic HTML, and accessibility best practices. I thrive in systems thinking and building UI experiences with a focus on consistency, scalability, and long‑term maintainability.

In my current role on the Truist Design System team, I work closely with designers and developers to translate Figma designs into polished, production‑ready HTML and CSS that strengthen our component library and elevate product quality.

Core skills:

- Fluency in semantic HTML and modern CSS
- Refined design sensibility with a strong focus on layout, motion, and visual detail
- Proven experience bridging the gap between design and engineering
- Design system development with a focus on consistency, reuse, and scalability
- Experience working with themes and design tokens
- Strong understanding of inclusive design and WCAG accessibility standards, including color contrast, touch targets, and screen reader considerations
- Rapid prototyping
- Experience working with LLMs and agentic workflows
- Figma
- Git, CI/CD tools
- Agile methodologies
- Adobe Creative Suite
- Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and HTL / Sightly
- JavaScript and TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Notable accomplishments:

• Original member of the Truist Design System, helping build and scale the system from the ground up
• Collaborated cross functionally to evolve components and drive adoption across the organization
• Translated Figma designs into accessible, production ready HTML and CSS for Angular and Web Component libraries
• Introduced modern CSS techniques and emerging standards into core components
• Provided thought leadership on color tokens and theming strategy
• Led the launch of Kickstart, a design system service supporting adoption and enablement
• Coordinated creation of custom design system documentation
positions.insights: Design systems, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +3 skills

positions.title: Principal UI Designer
positions.description:
Notable accomplishments:

• Shaped AEM component requirements used across Truist’s flagship site and 16 subsidiaries
• Built custom AEM component prototypes using HTL / Sightly
• Served as design lead for the BB&T public website responsive redesign, delivering an accessible and modern UI
• Named Banking Officer in Q3 2016
• Earned the Q4 2016 BB&T Olympian Award
• AEM certification Q3 2017
positions.insights: Design systems, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +5 skills

positions.title: Senior UI Designer
positions.description:
Notable accomplishments:

• Designed and developed responsive web templates aligned with university branding
• Led art direction for the 2012 ou.edu redesign
• Supported campus wide web content migrations
• Created print materials for campus campaigns and initiatives
positions.insights: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +3 skills

positions.title: Web & Graphic Designer / Marketing Associate
positions.description:
Notable accomplishments:

• Designed and developed the corporate website
• Managed Google AdWords and Analytics accounts
• Supported marketing campaigns, collateral, and IA improvements
